inferred_links.I1: The indexer passes each sidecar file of a location's sidecar folder to the reader when it indexes the location. Only the reader and its single caller (a queue pop) are read; the enqueueing is untraced. Shipped content depends on it. Affects every read case.
inferred_links.I2: A file's type, and so its kind, is determined from its lowercase extension through the registered extension list; the lookup function is not in kept evidence. Affects cases 1-11.
inferred_links.I3: An entry whose filePath names no indexed item is skipped without affecting other entries (the apply step 0x1006dbf98 is not traced; the shipped built-in sidecar has one such entry). Affects case 18. Review: confirmed by the 'binding' evidence (entries are only looked up by the names of F's files; unmatched entries are removed from the in-memory document afterwards).
inferred_links.I4: Assigned tags and labels are observable per item without inheritance from its folder. Affected 16 and 17, removed in review; no released case depends on it.
inferred_links.I5: The base folder of factory and built-in override sidecars is the User Library (config accessor untraced; the refusal message names it). Affects 26, 27.
inferred_links.I6: The pack identifier given to the override-name construction is the pack's packUniqueId as recorded in its own sidecar (supported by 159 of 160 Legacy Pack Data names). Affects 26 and the general rule.
inferred_links.I7: UUID text is lowercase with hyphens (formatter 0x100616d44 not kept; every shipped sidecar name is). Affects 23-27.
